operators.name: stack_like
semantics: Input is a contiguous or non-contiguous float32 tensor on CUDA
Return a contiguous tensor with identical values, shape, dtype, and device
Equivalent to reference unbind + PixelShuffle(1) + stack along dim=1
No numerical computation beyond copy; preserves values exactly
Splits input tensor along channel dimension (dim=1) into 32 tensors
Each slice is a view with shape [512, 128, 128] and strides (524288,128,1)
Order is preserved from original channel indices 0 to 31
Applies PixelShuffle with upscale_factor=1 to each slice
PixelShuffle(1) returns contiguous copy of input: stride (16384,128,1)
Values unchanged; output layout is contiguous
Returns final contiguous tensor with same values as input
